native_neighbors.name: Mean shift
native_neighbors.definition: Mode-seeking clustering that moves candidate centers toward local density maxima.

native_neighbors.name: Mean Teacher
native_neighbors.definition: A semi-supervised classifier-training procedure that regularizes a student prediction toward the prediction of a same-architecture teacher whose parameters are an exponential moving average of successive student parameters, alongside labeled classification loss.

native_neighbors.name: Memory-reduced best-first beam search for sequence decoding
native_neighbors.definition: A capacity-limited variant of per-length best-first sequence beam search that, when its chosen total queue capacity is reached, removes the worst-scoring active hypothesis from the earliest active sequence length.

native_neighbors.name: Metropolis-adjusted Langevin algorithm
native_neighbors.definition: A Metropolis–Hastings sampler that proposes a Gaussian step with drift proportional to the target log-density gradient and corrects the asymmetric proposal with an accept/reject test.

native_neighbors.name: Metropolis–Hastings sampling
native_neighbors.definition: A Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithm that proposes a new state from a specified transition distribution and accepts it with the smaller of one and the target-density ratio multiplied by the reverse-to-forward proposal ratio, otherwise retaining the current state.

native_neighbors.name: Metropolis-within-Gibbs sampling
native_neighbors.definition: A componentwise Monte Carlo scheme that uses Metropolis–Hastings transitions targeting full conditional distributions for one or more coordinate blocks, optionally combined with exact Gibbs updates for other blocks.

native_neighbors.name: MixMatch
native_neighbors.definition: A semi-supervised classifier-training procedure that averages predictions over augmented unlabeled inputs, sharpens the resulting soft targets, mixes augmented labeled and unlabeled input-target pairs, and optimizes labeled cross-entropy plus an unlabeled squared-probability loss.

native_neighbors.name: Mixed-membership model for scientific publications
native_neighbors.definition: A generative document model in which one Dirichlet-distributed membership vector mixes aspect-specific word distributions for an abstract and aspect-specific reference distributions for its bibliography.

native_neighbors.name: Mixed memory Markov model
native_neighbors.definition: A family of compact temporal probability models whose component transition distributions are convex mixtures of transition tables indexed by a single selected predecessor lag or component.

native_neighbors.name: Mixtures of Probabilistic Principal Component Analyzers
native_neighbors.definition: A finite Gaussian mixture whose components each have a linear standard-normal latent factor and component-specific isotropic observation noise, giving covariance W_i W_i^T+sigma_i^2 I and probabilistic assignments to local principal-component models.

native_neighbors.name: Monotonic Gaussian process with virtual derivatives
native_neighbors.definition: A Gaussian-process inference procedure that promotes monotonicity in selected input coordinates by combining observed outputs with finite virtual derivative-sign factors and approximating the resulting posterior using expectation propagation.

native_neighbors.name: Monte Carlo Expectation Maximization
native_neighbors.definition: An expectation-maximization method that approximates the current conditional expected complete-data log objective by Monte Carlo integration and maximizes that sampled objective to update the parameters.

native_neighbors.name: Multi-label text mixture model
native_neighbors.definition: A generative multi-label document model that selects a label subset and a mixture supported on that subset, then generates each word through one of the selected labels and its class-specific word distribution.

native_neighbors.name: Multiclass Multiple Kernel Maximum Margin Clustering
native_neighbors.definition: A multiclass unsupervised clustering procedure that jointly fits shared nonnegative multiple-kernel weights and latent class-score functions using winner-margin cutting planes and repeated convex conic fits.

native_neighbors.name: Multiple-testing node conflict diagnostic
native_neighbors.definition: A Bayesian evidence-synthesis diagnostic that partitions information at replicated separator nodes, stacks declared contrasts between transformed copies, and uses their joint covariance and a multivariate reference distribution to assess global and multiplicity-adjusted local conflict. Its single-step max-absolute-statistic adjustment accounts for correlation within an explicitly selected family of comparisons.

native_neighbors.name: Multiple-try Metropolis
native_neighbors.definition: A Metropolis sampling algorithm that selects a candidate from several weighted forward proposals, draws a backward reference set containing the original state, and corrects acceptance using the ratio of their total weights.

native_neighbors.name: Multiple-try Metropolis within Gibbs
native_neighbors.definition: A coordinate-update sampler that applies a multiple-try Metropolis transition to a conditional target while holding all other coordinates fixed.

native_neighbors.name: Multiview Kernel K-Means
native_neighbors.definition: A multiview clustering algorithm that alternates kernel k-means on a power-weighted combination of fixed view kernels with simplex view-weight updates minimizing within-cluster feature variance.

native_neighbors.name: Multiway Karmarkar–Karp differencing
native_neighbors.definition: A multiway number-partitioning heuristic that represents partial partitions by normalized bin-load vectors and repeatedly combines two selected subpartitions by pairing their largest and smallest bin loads, retaining one composition until a full partition remains.

native_neighbors.name: Muon optimizer
native_neighbors.definition: A neural-network optimization method that approximately orthogonalizes momentum-based matrix updates using Newton–Schulz iterations.

native_neighbors.name: Mutual information neural estimation
native_neighbors.definition: A mutual-information estimation procedure that trains a neural statistics function to maximize a Donsker–Varadhan objective contrasting joint samples with product-of-marginals samples, using stochastic optimization and an optional moving-average denominator for gradient estimation.

native_neighbors.name: Naive Bayes
native_neighbors.definition: Probabilistic classification assuming feature independence conditional on the class.

native_neighbors.name: Natural Evolution Strategies
native_neighbors.definition: A family of black-box optimization algorithms that adapts a parameterized search distribution using estimates of the natural gradient of expected fitness with respect to the distribution parameters.

native_neighbors.name: NeXO ontology alignment
native_neighbors.definition: An iterative ontology-alignment algorithm that combines shared-terminal set overlap with parent and child neighborhood similarities, then greedily selects one-to-one term correspondences while rejecting reversed ancestor relations.

native_neighbors.name: NeXO ontology construction
native_neighbors.definition: A network-based ontology-construction procedure that starts from a probabilistic hierarchy of gene communities, removes unsupported binary restrictions to permit multiway joins, and adds supported second-parent connections to produce an overlapping term hierarchy.

native_neighbors.name: Nearest-neighbor-chain clustering
native_neighbors.definition: An agglomerative clustering algorithm that follows a chain of nearest clusters until its last pair are reciprocal nearest neighbors, merges that pair, and reuses the remaining chain; for suitable distance updates, sorting and relabeling the recorded merges produces a valid stepwise hierarchy.

native_neighbors.name: Nearest-neighbor distance-norm data description
native_neighbors.definition: A one-class decision rule that forms the ordered distances from a query to its first k reference neighbors and accepts the query when the L_r norm of that distance vector is at most a supplied threshold, with self inclusion and infinite padding when fewer than k references exist.

native_neighbors.name: Nearest-neighbor ratio data description
native_neighbors.definition: A target-class data-description algorithm that scores a query by its distance to a nearest reference observation divided by that observation's nearest-other-reference spacing, and accepts queries whose ratio does not exceed a chosen threshold, where the denominator and neighbor-selection conventions are well defined.

native_neighbors.name: Neighbourhood components analysis
native_neighbors.definition: A supervised metric-learning algorithm that learns a linear transformation by maximizing the expected number of correctly classified training examples under stochastic leave-one-out neighbor selection.

native_neighbors.name: Neural probabilistic language model
native_neighbors.definition: A neural finite-context language architecture that jointly learns a shared word-embedding lookup and a nonlinear predictor of the next-word distribution using concatenated context embeddings and a vocabulary softmax.

native_neighbors.name: Neural variational inference and learning
native_neighbors.definition: A method for jointly training a directed latent-variable model and an amortized stochastic inference network by maximizing a variational log-likelihood bound, using score-function inference gradients with learned baselines and adaptive learning-signal normalization.

native_neighbors.name: Newman greedy modularity algorithm
native_neighbors.definition: Newman’s direct edge-fraction-matrix algorithm for greedy agglomerative community detection, which starts with singleton vertices, joins adjacent communities using modularity changes, updates the matrix by combining their rows and columns, and selects a maximum-modularity cut along the resulting merge history.

native_neighbors.name: Newman random-walk betweenness matrix computation
native_neighbors.definition: An exact network-analysis algorithm that computes random-walk betweenness from an embedded inverse of a grounded graph Laplacian, explicitly enumerates source–target pairs, and averages their incident-current magnitudes with a specified endpoint convention.

native_neighbors.name: Noisy-OR belief network
native_neighbors.definition: A directed acyclic binary probabilistic network that models a node’s inactivity as the product of a leak-failure factor and failure factors for its active parents.

native_neighbors.name: Noisy rectifier
native_neighbors.definition: A stochastic activation that adds zero-mean noise to a preactivation and then applies the positive-part rectifier, producing h=max(0,a+z).

native_neighbors.name: Non-conjugate variational message passing
native_neighbors.definition: An approximate inference algorithm that restricts variational blocks to exponential families and updates their natural parameters by matching expected-log-factor gradients through the sufficient-statistic covariance.

native_neighbors.name: Nonnegative Matrix Factorization
native_neighbors.definition: A matrix-decomposition method that represents or approximates a nonnegative data matrix as the product of two entrywise nonnegative factor matrices, so each data column is expressed by additive nonnegative combinations of basis columns.

native_neighbors.name: Nonparametric Bayes pachinko allocation model
native_neighbors.definition: A Bayesian pachinko topic-model family using coupled hierarchical Dirichlet-process allocations to infer occupied supertopics and shared subtopics, with subtopic allocation groups determined by latent supertopic assignments.

native_neighbors.name: Norm-stabilizer
native_neighbors.definition: A recurrent-network regularization procedure that adds a penalty on the average squared change in Euclidean norm between successive selected activation or state vectors during training.

native_neighbors.name: Novelty SAT heuristic
native_neighbors.definition: A clause-based SAT local-search heuristic that ranks candidate flips by total violation count with oldest-variable tie breaks, normally selects the best candidate, and sometimes selects the second-best when the best was the most recently flipped variable in that clause.

native_neighbors.name: Novelty+ SAT heuristic
native_neighbors.definition: A Novelty extension that, at each SAT search step, chooses a random variable from a randomly selected unsatisfied clause with a fixed walk probability and otherwise uses Novelty’s recency-conditioned best/second-best selector.

native_neighbors.name: NovoGrad
native_neighbors.definition: A stochastic gradient optimizer that rescales each parameter block gradient by a scalar running second moment of that block gradient norm before accumulating momentum, with an optional weight-decay contribution added after gradient normalization.

native_neighbors.name: Nu support vector classification
native_neighbors.definition: A supervised binary-classification algorithm that jointly fits a regularized kernel hyperplane and a nonnegative margin level, using nu to reward that level relative to linearly penalized margin shortfalls.

native_neighbors.name: OPTICS
native_neighbors.definition: Density-based clustering analysis that orders observations using reachability across neighborhood scales.

native_neighbors.name: Oja Learning Rule
native_neighbors.definition: A single-output linear-neuron learning rule that combines a Hebbian input-output weight increment with an output-squared weight decay, obtained as a first-order approximation to Euclidean-normalized Hebbian learning.

native_neighbors.name: Beam decoding with a monotone-score stopping certificate
native_neighbors.definition: A layer-based sequence beam decoder that retains the best completed hypothesis seen so far and stops when the highest current prefix score cannot exceed that incumbent under a score that never increases with extension.

native_neighbors.name: Order-agnostic NADE training
native_neighbors.definition: A stochastic training procedure that shares neural conditional parameters across variable orderings and estimates the order-averaged NADE log-likelihood objective using a sampled observed prefix and losses for all remaining variables.

native_neighbors.name: No-U-Turn sampler (original slice formulation)
native_neighbors.definition: The original 2014 slice-based NUTS algorithm, which adapts a Hamiltonian trajectory’s length through randomly directed binary-tree doubling and selects a valid next state while enforcing subtree U-turn and reversibility conditions.

native_neighbors.name: Orthogonal least squares forward selection
native_neighbors.definition: A greedy fixed-candidate regression algorithm that repeatedly adds the column giving the largest reduction in squared residual after joint least-squares refitting over the augmented selected span.

native_neighbors.name: Orthogonal matching pursuit
native_neighbors.definition: A greedy fixed-dictionary approximation algorithm that selects an atom correlated with the current residual and recomputes the approximation as the orthogonal projection of the signal onto the span of all selected atoms.

native_neighbors.name: Otsu thresholding
native_neighbors.definition: A histogram-based threshold-selection algorithm that partitions ordered gray levels by maximizing class-weighted between-class variance, equivalently minimizing within-class variance for a fixed histogram.

native_neighbors.name: Overlapping hierarchical clustering (OHC)
native_neighbors.definition: A graph-based agglomerative clustering algorithm that expands clusters across increasing distance thresholds when the change in induced edge density is within a tolerance, retaining overlapping groups in a cluster-inclusion hierarchy.

native_neighbors.name: PERCH clustering
native_neighbors.definition: An online hierarchical clustering algorithm that inserts observations near existing leaves of a binary cluster tree and uses masking and balance rotations to revise subtree placement.

native_neighbors.name: PHATE
native_neighbors.definition: A dimensionality-reduction algorithm that computes diffusion transition probabilities, measures Euclidean distances between their negative-log rows, and uses metric multidimensional scaling to embed those potential distances.

native_neighbors.name: PaCMAP
native_neighbors.definition: A nonlinear dimensionality-reduction algorithm that embeds neighbor, mid-near and farther point pairs using separate attractive and repulsive losses whose relative weights change through three optimization phases.

native_neighbors.name: Pachinko allocation model
native_neighbors.definition: A topic-model family that generates each word by traversing a directed acyclic graph from a root through topic nodes to a word leaf, using probability distributions over each node's children.

native_neighbors.name: PageRank
native_neighbors.definition: A link-analysis ranking algorithm that assigns node scores using a random walk mixing normalized outgoing-link transitions with teleportation to a specified restart distribution, under an explicit policy for nodes with no outgoing weight.

native_neighbors.name: Paired differencing method
native_neighbors.definition: A two-way number-partitioning heuristic that sorts residuals and differences disjoint adjacent pairs in whole rounds, carries an unpaired residual forward, and repeats until one residual remains, producing a partition whose subset cardinalities differ by at most one.

native_neighbors.name: Pairwise Markov chain
native_neighbors.definition: A hidden-state sequence-model family in which the joint process of a hidden variable and its corresponding observation is first-order Markov, without requiring either marginal process to be Markov or observations to be conditionally independent given the hidden path.

native_neighbors.name: Pairwise Markov tree
native_neighbors.definition: A latent-variable tree-model family whose paired hidden and observed states factor into a root distribution and parent-to-child conditional kernels on a fixed rooted tree, without requiring the hidden marginal to be Markov on that tree.

native_neighbors.name: Papadimitriou 2-SAT random walk
native_neighbors.definition: A randomized 2-SAT search procedure that starts from any complete truth assignment and repeatedly selects an unsatisfied clause and flips a uniformly chosen literal’s variable until a satisfying assignment is reached or a selected move budget ends.

native_neighbors.name: Parallel alternating Newton-like algorithm for APM
native_neighbors.definition: A block-alternating Newton-like method for fitting an admixture of Poisson Markov random fields through a sparsity-penalized nodewise Poisson regression surrogate, alternating topic coefficients with document-specific simplex weights and parallelizing independent subproblems.

native_neighbors.name: Parallel tempering
native_neighbors.definition: A population Monte Carlo method that combines within-temperature target-preserving updates with corrected exchanges between replicas targeting differently tempered densities.

native_neighbors.name: ParamILS
native_neighbors.definition: An iterated-local-search framework for algorithm configuration that searches finite parameter settings through one-parameter neighborhood moves, perturbations and random restarts, with a replaceable procedure for comparing configurations on target-algorithm runs.

native_neighbors.name: Parameter-Expanded Expectation Maximization
native_neighbors.definition: An expectation-maximization construction that fits an expanded complete-data model with auxiliary parameters, reduces its result to the original observed-data parameterization through a likelihood-preserving map, and resets the auxiliary parameters before the next iteration.

native_neighbors.name: Parametric UMAP
native_neighbors.definition: A parametric dimensionality-reduction algorithm that trains a neural mapping from input points to embedding coordinates using sampled attractive and repulsive losses derived from a UMAP neighborhood graph.

native_neighbors.name: Tree-size estimation by partial backtracking
native_neighbors.definition: A randomized backtracking-tree estimator that explores a uniformly selected subset of successors at each visited branching point and uses inverse inclusion weights to estimate the total cost of candidate examinations in the corresponding complete fixed search.

native_neighbors.name: Partial least squares regression
native_neighbors.definition: Regression using latent components chosen to capture predictor-response covariance.

native_neighbors.name: Partially noncentered GLMM variational inference
native_neighbors.definition: A Bayesian generalized linear mixed-model inference procedure that uses cluster-specific partial noncentering to define independent Gaussian fixed-effect and transformed random-effect blocks, factors an inverse-Wishart random-effect covariance, and alternates nonconjugate Gaussian message proposals with an exact covariance coordinate.

native_neighbors.name: Partially observable Markov decision process
native_neighbors.definition: A Markov decision model in which observations provide incomplete information about the current state.

native_neighbors.name: Particle swarm optimization
native_neighbors.definition: A population-based optimization method that moves candidate particles through a search space using retained velocities and stochastic attraction toward remembered personal and shared best positions.

native_neighbors.name: Path integral clustering
native_neighbors.definition: An agglomerative clustering algorithm that merges clusters with the greatest increase in their size-normalized sums of discounted random-walk paths when paths are allowed through the proposed union.

native_neighbors.name: Patience-controlled FCFS beam decoding
native_neighbors.definition: A generalization of first-come, first-served sequence beam decoding that retains beam width k for continuing hypotheses but uses a positive patience factor p to stop when the accumulated completed-hypothesis count reaches at least k·p.

native_neighbors.name: Persistent contrastive divergence
native_neighbors.definition: A learning algorithm that estimates an energy model’s negative-phase statistics with Markov chains whose states persist across parameter updates, rather than restarting those chains at the current data minibatch.

native_neighbors.name: Pi-model
native_neighbors.definition: A semi-supervised classifier-training procedure that combines labeled cross-entropy with squared disagreement between two stochastic predictions of the same input from a shared-parameter network, propagating gradients through both predictions.

native_neighbors.name: PoClustering edge-clique-cover heuristic
native_neighbors.definition: An approximate PoClustering algorithm that incrementally extends and prunes clique sets to cover the edges of dissimilarity-threshold graphs, retaining a potentially smaller overlapping cluster family than exhaustive maximal-clique enumeration.

native_neighbors.name: PointNet++
native_neighbors.definition: A hierarchical point-set neural architecture that repeatedly samples centroids, groups metric neighborhoods and applies local PointNet feature extraction, with multi-scale or multi-resolution constructions for variable sampling density.

native_neighbors.name: Poisson generalized root model
native_neighbors.definition: A generalized root probability model on unbounded nonnegative integer counts, with factorial base measures and symmetric products of j-th roots involving at most j distinct variables, normalizable for every finite parameter tensor on a finite variable set.

native_neighbors.name: Poisson square root graphical model
native_neighbors.definition: A square-root graphical model on unbounded nonnegative integer counts with factorial base measures, unary square-root and linear count terms and pairwise products of square roots of counts, normalizable for all finite symmetric interaction and unary parameters on a finite graph.

native_neighbors.name: Population Based Augmentation
native_neighbors.definition: An augmentation-schedule learning procedure that jointly trains a population of child classifiers and evolves their augmentation hyperparameters by copying successful members and perturbing their policies over training time.

native_neighbors.name: Population-based incremental learning
native_neighbors.definition: An optimization method that samples candidate solutions from a probability-vector representation and incrementally moves that representation toward high-evaluation sampled solutions, with probability-vector mutation in its basic formulation.

native_neighbors.name: Power iteration clustering
native_neighbors.definition: A clustering algorithm that uses an early-stopped power iteration of a normalized similarity matrix to embed observations and then applies k-means to their embedding coordinates.

native_neighbors.name: Preconditioned Crank–Nicolson sampling
native_neighbors.definition: A Metropolis sampler for a Gaussian-reference target whose proposal combines the current state with an independent draw from that reference using a scalar autoregressive coefficient.

native_neighbors.name: Preconditioned Crank–Nicolson Langevin sampling
native_neighbors.definition: A Metropolis-corrected Gaussian-reference sampler that preconditions the potential-gradient drift by the reference covariance and uses a scalar Crank–Nicolson autoregressive update.

native_neighbors.name: Bounded word reward with predicted length
native_neighbors.definition: A sequence rescoring method that adds a fixed word reward only up to an input-specific length predicted from encoder states, replacing a corpus-level generation-ratio cap with Lpred(x).

native_neighbors.name: Principal Curves
native_neighbors.definition: A nonlinear statistical summary defined by a smooth curve that is self-consistent for a data distribution: almost every point on the curve equals the conditional mean of observations whose nearest-point projection lands there.

native_neighbors.name: Probabilistic latent semantic analysis
native_neighbors.definition: A latent-class model of document–word or other dyadic co-occurrences that represents their joint probability as a mixture of conditionally independent distributions over the two observed entities.

native_neighbors.name: Probabilistic Principal Component Analysis
native_neighbors.definition: A linear Gaussian latent-variable model with a standard-normal latent prior and isotropic observation noise, whose maximum-likelihood loading subspace corresponds to leading principal components under the stated covariance-rank conditions.

native_neighbors.name: Product of experts
native_neighbors.definition: A probabilistic model family that combines expert factors over the same observations by multiplying their values and normalizing the product over the observation space.

native_neighbors.name: Product of hidden Markov models
native_neighbors.definition: A sequence-model family that multiplies the marginal probabilities assigned to a complete observation sequence by several hidden Markov models and normalizes the product over sequences of the same length.

native_neighbors.name: Professor forcing
native_neighbors.definition: An adversarial recurrent-network training procedure that retains teacher-forced likelihood learning while training an auxiliary discriminator and the generator to reduce differences between teacher-forced and free-running behavior sequences.

native_neighbors.name: Prototype-based domain description
native_neighbors.definition: A one-class decision rule that accepts a query when its metric distance to at least one prototype, plus that prototype's stored radius offset, is no greater than a common threshold.

native_neighbors.name: Pseudo-Label
native_neighbors.definition: A semi-supervised neural-network training procedure that recomputes hard labels from the model’s most probable class for unlabeled examples and jointly fits observed and generated targets using a scheduled weight on the unlabeled loss.

native_neighbors.name: Q-learning
native_neighbors.definition: A model-free reinforcement-learning method that incrementally updates action-value estimates toward an observed reward plus the discounted maximum estimated value of the next state’s actions.

native_neighbors.name: Quadratic discriminant analysis
native_neighbors.definition: Gaussian discriminant classification with class-specific covariance matrices.

native_neighbors.name: Quadratic Poisson graphical model
native_neighbors.definition: A graphical probability model on nonnegative integer counts whose joint log mass contains unary linear terms, site quadratic terms and symmetric pairwise count products, with parameters restricted to make its infinite-support partition function finite.

native_neighbors.name: Rectified Adam
native_neighbors.definition: An Adam-family optimizer that rectifies its adaptive update using a time-dependent estimate of the effective history of the second-moment statistic.

native_neighbors.name: Recursive best-first search with controlled re-expansion
native_neighbors.definition: An RBFS variant that estimates subtree evaluation-value distributions and inflates backed-up values to make later visits expand geometrically more nodes, while retaining original lower-bound information for solution-cost pruning.

native_neighbors.name: REINFORCE
native_neighbors.definition: A family of stochastic reinforcement-learning update rules that multiply a sampled reward relative to an admissible baseline by the derivative of the log probability of the sampled action or unit output, with a nonnegative learning-rate factor.

native_neighbors.name: R-Novelty SAT heuristic
native_neighbors.definition: A Novelty-derived SAT heuristic whose choice between the best and second-best flips depends on their objective-score gap when the best variable was most recently flipped; its original 1997 search strategy also includes a periodic random clause-variable move.

native_neighbors.name: R-Novelty+ SAT heuristic
native_neighbors.definition: The 1999 R-Novelty extension that replaces its periodic random override with a fixed per-step probability of a random clause-variable flip and otherwise uses the recency- and score-gap-dependent R-Novelty selector.

native_neighbors.name: ROCK clustering
native_neighbors.definition: An agglomerative clustering procedure that merges clusters using shared-neighbor link counts divided by a cluster-size normalization derived from a neighborhood model.

native_neighbors.name: Radicchi edge-clustering community detection
native_neighbors.definition: A divisive graph-community algorithm family that repeatedly removes edges with the lowest modified cycle-based edge-clustering score, updates affected local scores and forms a component hierarchy, optionally retaining branches through the paper’s original-adjacency strong or weak community tests.

native_neighbors.name: RandAugment
native_neighbors.definition: An image-augmentation procedure that applies a uniformly sampled sequence of operations sharing one magnitude parameter, reducing augmentation selection to tuning the operation count and shared magnitude on the target task.

native_neighbors.name: Random Online Aggressive Racing
native_neighbors.definition: An algorithm-configuration procedure that proposes uniformly random parameter settings and compares each challenger with an incumbent through adaptive evaluations on shared problem instances and random seeds, without fitting a predictive performance model.

native_neighbors.name: Random-only abstraction for abstraction sampling
native_neighbors.definition: A randomized abstraction rule for graphical-model sampling that uniformly permutes the current search nodes and divides that order into groups of nearly equal cardinality, within which the surrounding sampler selects and importance-weights representatives.

native_neighbors.name: Random Search for Hyperparameter Optimization
native_neighbors.definition: A hyperparameter optimization procedure that draws trial configurations independently from a specified search distribution, evaluates their validation performance, and selects a favorable evaluated configuration without adapting subsequent draws to observed trial scores.

native_neighbors.name: Random-walk Metropolis–Hastings sampling
native_neighbors.definition: A Metropolis–Hastings sampler that proposes a new state by adding an increment drawn from a fixed distribution independent of the current state.

native_neighbors.name: Randomized latent score conflict diagnostic
native_neighbors.definition: A Bayesian hierarchical-model diagnostic that freezes draws from a parent posterior excluding selected child data, draws child latent parameters conditionally, and compares derivatives of an expanded conditional log prior with scores of conditional-prior replicates. The resulting randomized tail values are examined and optionally combined as a model-conflict summary, with calibration depending on the actual sampling law, score direction and aggregation.

native_neighbors.name: Rank-based Ant System
native_neighbors.definition: An Ant System variant that weights pheromone deposits from a selected number of the current iteration’s best tours by rank and adds a separate reinforced contribution from the best-so-far tour.

native_neighbors.name: RAPID support vector data description sampling
native_neighbors.definition: A density-based training-subset selection method for support vector data description that prefilters low-density observations and greedily removes high-density inliers while testing a retained-density threshold on the original inlier set.

native_neighbors.name: ReMixMatch
native_neighbors.definition: A semi-supervised classifier-training procedure that adjusts weak-view guessed labels toward an estimated class prior, sharpens and anchors those soft targets across strong augmentations, and trains with interpolated pairs plus unmixed consistency and rotation-prediction losses.

native_neighbors.name: Real-time A*
native_neighbors.definition: A real-time heuristic search algorithm that moves to a neighbor with minimum edge-cost-plus-heuristic estimate and stores the second-best such estimate at the state it leaves, using bounded lookahead or initial heuristics for previously unvisited states.

native_neighbors.name: Real-time recurrent learning
native_neighbors.definition: A recurrent-network training algorithm that propagates state sensitivities to adjustable weights forward in time and contracts those sensitivities with current supervised output errors to form weight updates.

native_neighbors.name: Reciprocal-nearest-neighbors supported clustering
native_neighbors.definition: A hierarchical clustering algorithm that follows nearest-neighbor chains to construct sub-clustering trees around reciprocal pairs, prunes overly deep nodes into singleton trees, and recursively clusters representatives formed from the supporting pairs.

native_neighbors.name: Rectified flow
native_neighbors.definition: A transport-learning method that regresses a velocity field on endpoint differences along straight interpolations of coupled samples and uses the resulting ordinary differential equation to transport the source distribution, optionally repeating rectification using the learned endpoint coupling.

native_neighbors.name: Recurrent temporal restricted Boltzmann machine
native_neighbors.definition: A recurrent neural sequence architecture whose deterministic state is a conditional RBM hidden-probability vector and sets the next step’s hidden bias, with visible observations drawn from that step’s RBM marginal.

native_neighbors.name: Recursive best-first search
native_neighbors.definition: A recursive search algorithm that explores the best stored subtree alternative within an upper bound and conditionally passes a previously backed-up value to regenerated children, retaining path and sibling information instead of the full best-first frontier.

native_neighbors.name: Recursive prediction-error estimation
native_neighbors.definition: A recursive parameter-estimation method that incrementally adjusts a parameterized predictor using prediction errors and search directions based on its parameter sensitivities.

native_neighbors.name: Regularized information maximization
native_neighbors.definition: A discriminative clustering framework that fits conditional class probabilities by maximizing empirical input–assignment mutual information penalized by classifier complexity, with linear and kernel softmax configurations.

native_neighbors.name: Rejection-driven independence Metropolis sampling
native_neighbors.definition: An independence Metropolis sampler whose proposals are generated by a rejection procedure with a fixed possibly non-dominating envelope, followed by a Metropolis correction for the resulting clipped proposal law.

native_neighbors.name: Rejection sampling
native_neighbors.definition: A random-variate generation algorithm that draws proposals from a normalized envelope dominating an unnormalized target and accepts each with the target-to-envelope ratio, yielding independent target draws with fresh independent random trials.

native_neighbors.name: Relevance-weighted topic distillation
native_neighbors.definition: An iterative web-link ranking procedure that alternates authority and hub score propagation using destination relevance for forward contributions and source relevance for backward contributions, retaining inter-site links and restricting authority eligibility by relevance.

native_neighbors.name: Relevant component analysis
native_neighbors.definition: A partially supervised linear metric-learning procedure that estimates within-group covariance from positive equivalence constraints and whitens the representation using that covariance.

native_neighbors.name: Restricted Boltzmann Machine Collaborative Filtering
native_neighbors.definition: A family of shared-parameter restricted Boltzmann models for categorical user-item ratings, with a user-specific visible set and optional conditioning on the item-observation mask and low-rank factorization of rating interactions.

native_neighbors.name: Retentive network
native_neighbors.definition: An autoregressive neural sequence architecture that stacks pre-normalized residual blocks combining gated multi-scale retention with feedforward transformations, with parallel, recurrent and chunkwise forms of retention.

native_neighbors.name: Reweighted wake-sleep
native_neighbors.definition: A learning procedure for paired generative and inference networks that uses multiple inference samples and normalized importance weights for generative-model updates, with recognition updates from importance-weighted observed-data samples, model-generated sleep samples, or both.

native_neighbors.name: Robust adaptive Metropolis
native_neighbors.definition: An adaptive random-walk Metropolis algorithm that updates the proposal shape factor by a rank-one transformation driven by the proposal direction and the difference between its acceptance probability and a chosen target rate.

native_neighbors.name: Robust continuous clustering
native_neighbors.definition: A clustering algorithm that optimizes one representative per observation using squared data fidelity and robust attraction along a neighborhood graph, then extracts groups from thresholded connectivity between the optimized representatives.

native_neighbors.name: Role-author-recipient-topic model
native_neighbors.definition: A family of message-content models in which actors have latent-role distributions and ordered sender-role/recipient-role pairs determine topic mixtures, with token-level or message-level role assignments.

native_neighbors.name: Structured state space sequence model
native_neighbors.definition: A structured linear state-space sequence model whose normal-plus-low-rank state matrix is transformed to diagonal-plus-low-rank form for efficient convolution-kernel computation and recurrent sequence evaluation.

native_neighbors.name: Submodular pick LIME
native_neighbors.definition: A method selecting a budgeted set of local LIME explanations by greedily increasing weighted coverage of explanatory features.

native_neighbors.name: SamplePairing
native_neighbors.definition: An image-classification augmentation procedure that averages an anchor image with a randomly selected training image using equal pixel weights and trains against the anchor image’s label, with a training schedule that includes phases without pairing.

native_neighbors.name: Sarsa
native_neighbors.definition: An on-policy temporal-difference control algorithm that updates the current state-action value toward the observed reward plus the discounted estimated value of the next action selected by the same behavior policy.

native_neighbors.name: Scheduled sampling
native_neighbors.definition: An autoregressive sequence-training procedure that chooses between reference and model-produced previous outputs as feedback, using a schedule that progressively reduces the probability of reference feedback.

native_neighbors.name: SeLa
native_neighbors.definition: A self-supervised representation-learning procedure that alternates neural pseudo-label prediction and dataset-wide self-labelling through an entropy-regularized balanced optimal-transport assignment.

native_neighbors.name: Semidefinite Maximum Margin Clustering
native_neighbors.definition: A binary clustering procedure that relaxes latent label-equivalence matrices to a convex semidefinite program for a fixed-kernel soft-margin objective and recovers soft assignments from the leading matrix eigenvector.

native_neighbors.name: Semisupervised Semidefinite Maximum Margin Clustering
native_neighbors.definition: A semisupervised binary margin-learning procedure that adds observed-label pair constraints and labeled-to-unlabeled linkage constraints to the Xu2004 semidefinite label-matrix relaxation.

native_neighbors.name: Separator-node conflict diagnostic
native_neighbors.definition: A Bayesian graphical-model diagnostic that duplicates a selected separator node or node vector, partitions the information informing it, and compares the resulting partition-specific distributions on a declared scale. It assesses local incompatibility through explicitly chosen discrete agreement, signed-tail, radial or density-level scores, with nuisance dependence handled by a specified split or cut.

native_neighbors.name: A-star beam search for sequence decoding
native_neighbors.definition: A sequence-decoding beam framework that ranks active hypotheses by accumulated score plus an optimistic future-score heuristic, uses shorter length to break score ties, and limits accepted expansions to k hypotheses per sequence length.

native_neighbors.name: Best-first beam search with per-length budgets
native_neighbors.definition: The sequence-decoding beam procedure of Meister, Vieira and Cotterell that prioritizes active hypotheses by decreasing accumulated score, breaks score ties by shorter length, and limits accepted expansions to k hypotheses at each sequence length without a future-score heuristic.

native_neighbors.name: Sequential Model-based Algorithm Configuration
native_neighbors.definition: A sequential algorithm-configuration procedure that uses random-forest performance models to propose parameter settings and compares candidate settings with an incumbent through adaptive evaluations on shared problem instances and random seeds.

native_neighbors.name: Set Transformer
native_neighbors.definition: A neural encoder-decoder architecture for permutation-invariant set-input prediction that uses attention to encode interactions among elements and learned seed queries to aggregate encoded features.

native_neighbors.name: Sigmoid belief network
native_neighbors.definition: A directed acyclic probabilistic network of binary variables whose forward conditional probabilities are logistic functions of weighted parent states and a bias.

native_neighbors.name: Simple recursive best-first search
native_neighbors.definition: A recursive best-first search procedure that initializes generated children from their static evaluation values, explores the best child within an alternative-derived bound, and backs up returned values to decide which subtree to revisit.

native_neighbors.name: Simulated annealing
native_neighbors.definition: A stochastic optimization procedure that explores candidate configurations with temperature-controlled acceptance of cost-increasing moves and progressively cools that acceptance process to concentrate search on low-cost configurations.

native_neighbors.name: Single-step parametric maxT inference
native_neighbors.definition: A simultaneous-inference procedure for a declared family of linear functions of model parameters that standardizes joint estimates and uses the maximum absolute statistic under a centered multivariate normal or t reference to compute multiplicity-adjusted tests and a common critical value for simultaneous intervals. Exact or asymptotic validity depends on the joint sampling law and covariance estimation.

native_neighbors.name: Slice sampling
native_neighbors.definition: An auxiliary-variable Monte Carlo method that augments a target density with a uniform height below its graph and updates the state using a transition preserving the uniform distribution on the resulting density slice.

native_neighbors.name: Smart Augmentation
native_neighbors.definition: A learned augmentation procedure that trains a network to synthesize examples from same-class inputs while receiving both a within-class reference loss and feedback through the target classifier’s training loss.

native_neighbors.name: Soft actor-critic
native_neighbors.definition: An off-policy actor-critic algorithm fitting a stochastic policy and soft value functions under a reward-plus-policy-entropy objective.

native_neighbors.name: Space-Alternating Generalized Expectation Maximization
native_neighbors.definition: A generalized expectation-maximization method that updates selected parameter blocks using block-specific hidden-data spaces or valid objective-improvement surrogates, refreshing the conditional expectation or surrogate at the current estimate before the next block.

native_neighbors.name: Sparse additive generative model
native_neighbors.definition: A generative model family for categorical text data that forms word probabilities by normalizing a background log-frequency vector plus sparse component deviations, allowing multiple generative facets to combine additively in log space.

native_neighbors.name: Sparse Expectation Maximization
native_neighbors.definition: An EM variant that updates relative latent-state probabilities within selected plausible sets while preserving their total mass and all outside probabilities, and fits parameters using the resulting full distributions with occasional complete posterior refreshes.

native_neighbors.name: Sparse pachinko allocation inference
native_neighbors.definition: An approximate pachinko-allocation fitting procedure that restricts token path resampling to currently active document topics and word-associated subtopics, interleaving full sampling with pruning and optionally growing the training corpus incrementally.

native_neighbors.name: Sparse-spectrum Gaussian-process exact moment matching
native_neighbors.definition: An uncertain-input prediction algorithm that analytically integrates sine/cosine feature moments of a fixed sparse-spectrum Gaussian-process posterior over an independently prescribed Gaussian input and represents the output by a Gaussian with the resulting exact mean and covariance.

native_neighbors.name: Sparse-spectrum Gaussian-process linearized uncertain-input prediction
native_neighbors.definition: A local uncertain-input prediction algorithm for a fixed sparse-spectrum Gaussian-process posterior that linearizes the posterior mean at the Gaussian input mean, freezes the conditional variance there, and uses the resulting approximate mean and covariance for a Gaussian output representation.

native_neighbors.name: Sparse-spectrum Gaussian-process regression
native_neighbors.definition: A Gaussian-process regression model family whose latent prior is a finite sum of paired sine and cosine features with independent Gaussian coefficients, yielding a stationary finite-spectral covariance and Gaussian fixed-input predictions under Gaussian observation noise.

native_neighbors.name: Spatial Transformer
native_neighbors.definition: A learnable neural-network component that predicts an input-dependent spatial transformation and uses the resulting sampling grid to warp an image or feature tensor.

native_neighbors.name: Spectral hashing
native_neighbors.definition: An unsupervised binary-code learning algorithm that approximates a spectral similarity-preservation objective using a PCA-aligned rectangular data model and zero-thresholded single-coordinate analytic modes.

native_neighbors.name: Square root graphical model
native_neighbors.definition: A family of finite undirected graphical probability models that retains univariate base measures while coupling specified square roots of sufficient statistics through unary terms and a symmetric quadratic form, with parameters restricted to a finite joint partition function.

native_neighbors.name: Stacking
native_neighbors.definition: Ensemble learning that trains a final estimator on base-estimator predictions.

native_neighbors.name: Stepping-out slice sampling
native_neighbors.definition: A univariate slice-sampling algorithm that randomly places a width-w interval around the current point, expands it in width-w steps under a randomly divided budget, and samples by slice-aware interval shrinkage.

native_neighbors.name: Stochastic Approximation Expectation Maximization
native_neighbors.definition: An incomplete-data fitting method that recursively averages simulated complete-data log objectives or sufficient statistics using a step-size sequence, then maximizes the accumulated objective to update the model parameters.

native_neighbors.name: Stochastic beam search
native_neighbors.definition: The sequence-sampling algorithm of Kool, van Hoof and Welling that implements Gumbel-Top-k without replacement implicitly on a locally normalized sequence tree by propagating conditional perturbed subtree maxima and retaining the k highest-scoring prefixes at each level.

native_neighbors.name: Stochastic depth
native_neighbors.definition: A residual-network training procedure that randomly bypasses residual transformations during training and uses all residual transformations with survival-probability scaling during inference.

native_neighbors.name: Stochastic Expectation Maximization
native_neighbors.definition: A finite-mixture fitting algorithm that draws one hard component assignment for each observation from its current posterior responsibilities, fits the resulting completed-data model, and recomputes the responsibilities for the next iteration.

native_neighbors.name: Stochastic factorized variational sparse-spectrum Gaussian-process inference
native_neighbors.definition: The Gal–Turner stochastic extension of factorized variational sparse-spectrum regression that estimates its full-data evidence lower bound with uniformly sampled observation minibatches, scaling likelihood contributions by the population-to-batch ratio while retaining global KL penalties once.

native_neighbors.name: Stochastic gradient descent
native_neighbors.definition: Optimization using gradients estimated from sampled training observations.

native_neighbors.name: Stochastic nonconjugate GLMM variational inference
native_neighbors.definition: A finite-population Bayesian GLMM inference procedure that iterates selected cluster-local Gaussian factors and uses expanded cluster minibatch contributions to damp global Gaussian and inverse-Wishart natural parameters. This record follows the Tan–Nott natural-gradient derivation with its complete covariance target and explicit sampling and local-solution qualifications.

native_neighbors.name: Stochastic Pooling
native_neighbors.definition: A spatial neural pooling layer that samples one activation per region with probability proportional to its nonnegative value during training and uses an activation-weighted regional mean during deterministic inference.

native_neighbors.name: Stochastic-times-smooth unit
native_neighbors.definition: A stochastic activation that sets p=sigmoid(a), samples a Bernoulli gate with success probability sqrt(p), and outputs the gate multiplied by sqrt(p).

native_neighbors.name: Straight-through estimator
native_neighbors.definition: A surrogate-gradient rule that keeps a hard threshold or sampled binary output in the forward computation while propagating its downstream derivative backward as though the hard operation were the identity function.

native_neighbors.name: Straight-through Gumbel-Softmax estimator
native_neighbors.definition: A surrogate-gradient estimator that uses a hard one-hot argmax of a Gumbel-Softmax sample in the forward computation and substitutes the corresponding continuous softmax relaxation’s derivative in the backward computation.

native_neighbors.name: Strategic oscillation
native_neighbors.definition: A search-control strategy that alternates search directions or regimes around selected boundaries, controlling excursions and returns to explore solutions beyond the region of a single one-direction search.

native_neighbors.name: Structurally constrained recurrent neural network
native_neighbors.definition: A recurrent sequence architecture coupling a nonlinear recurrent hidden state with a separate linear context state whose recurrence is constrained to a scalar or diagonal decay, with context-to-hidden connections and no hidden-to-context feedback.

native_neighbors.name: Structured mean-field inference
native_neighbors.definition: A variational inference method that approximates a target distribution with a tractable family retaining selected dependencies, choosing its parameters to reduce the approximation-to-target Kullback–Leibler divergence.

native_neighbors.name: Structured variational inference for factorial HMMs
native_neighbors.definition: A variational inference procedure for factorial hidden Markov models that approximates the posterior by independent chain-path distributions while retaining temporal dependence within each chain.

native_neighbors.name: Sub-Cluster Component clustering
native_neighbors.definition: An agglomerative clustering algorithm that repeatedly merges weakly connected components of a thresholded nearest-neighbor graph over the current clusters, producing nested partitions with potentially nonbinary merges.

native_neighbors.name: Sublinear Poisson graphical model
native_neighbors.definition: A finite-graph model for unbounded nonnegative integer counts that retains factorial base measures while replacing counts in unary and pairwise interactions by a specified bounded, saturating sufficient statistic.

native_neighbors.name: Successive Halving
native_neighbors.definition: A staged best-candidate selection algorithm that divides a resource budget across elimination rounds, evaluates surviving candidates with comparable within-round effort, removes approximately the poorer-performing half, and allocates more effort per remaining candidate in later rounds.

native_neighbors.name: Supervised Principal Components
native_neighbors.definition: A prediction procedure that screens features by their marginal association with an outcome, computes principal components of the retained feature matrix, and uses those components in an outcome regression.

native_neighbors.name: Supplemented Expectation Conditional Maximization
native_neighbors.definition: A numerical supplement to expectation conditional maximization that recovers observed-data asymptotic parameter covariance from expected complete-data information and the local derivatives of both the ECM update and its frozen-expectation conditional-maximization sweep.

native_neighbors.name: Supplemented Expectation Maximization
native_neighbors.definition: A numerical supplement to expectation maximization that combines expected complete-data information with the local Jacobian of the EM update map to estimate the observed-data asymptotic parameter covariance.

native_neighbors.name: Support Vector Clustering
native_neighbors.definition: An unsupervised clustering procedure that fits a soft enclosing sphere to observations in Gaussian-kernel feature space, then labels retained observations by connected components of a graph whose input-space segments remain within the sphere preimage.

native_neighbors.name: Support vector data description
native_neighbors.definition: A one-class support-estimation algorithm that learns a sphere in an input or kernel feature space by minimizing squared radius plus linearly penalized nonnegative distance-constraint violations, then accepts a query when its feature lies within or on the learned sphere.

native_neighbors.name: SwAV
native_neighbors.definition: An online self-supervised visual representation-learning procedure that predicts soft prototype assignments of one augmented image view from other views, using entropy-regularized balanced assignment and jointly learned features and prototypes.

native_neighbors.name: Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique
native_neighbors.definition: A minority-class oversampling method that generates synthetic labeled feature vectors by interpolating between an observed minority example and selected neighbors from the same class.

native_neighbors.name: T-Few Fine-Tuning
native_neighbors.definition: A few-shot classification fine-tuning recipe that adapts a pretrained T0 model through IA3 activation vectors, multitask pretraining of those vectors and combined language-modeling, unlikelihood and length-normalized candidate objectives, with documented task-specific exceptions.

native_neighbors.name: Tractable unnormalized Barber–Agakov bound
native_neighbors.definition: A tractable unnormalized Barber–Agakov lower-bound parameterization that uses a real critic and a positive output-dependent normalizer to replace an intractable log partition term by a linear upper bound.

native_neighbors.name: Tabu search
native_neighbors.definition: A memory-guided optimization framework that steers a search trajectory by making selected moves temporarily inadmissible from search history, allowing non-improving moves and, where specified, aspiration-based overrides.

native_neighbors.name: Tempered expectation maximization
native_neighbors.definition: An entropy-tempered generalization of expectation maximization for finite latent-state models that alternates powered latent-joint responsibilities with weighted complete-log-likelihood parameter updates at a positive inverse temperature.

native_neighbors.name: Temporal-difference learning
native_neighbors.definition: A family of prediction-learning methods that assign temporal credit using discrepancies between successive, recursively related predictions of future outcomes, with intervening costs or rewards included when the target is cumulative.

native_neighbors.name: Temporal ensembling
native_neighbors.definition: A semi-supervised classifier-training procedure that regularizes a current stochastic prediction toward a bias-corrected exponential average of earlier predictions for the same indexed training example, alongside labeled cross-entropy.

native_neighbors.name: Temporal factored restricted Boltzmann machine language model
native_neighbors.definition: A sequential extension of the factored RBM language model that directs information from the preceding binary hidden state into the current hidden bias, propagating context beyond the explicit word window.

native_neighbors.name: Topic-model evocation score
native_neighbors.definition: A topic-model evaluation method that orders judged word pairs by model-derived weights and sums their human evocation ratings over a chosen number of highest-ranked pairs, with alternative aggregations across topics.

native_neighbors.name: Topographic Independent Component Analysis
native_neighbors.definition: A linear latent-component model whose otherwise conditionally independent source components share random scales through fixed overlapping neighborhoods, allowing nearby component energies to be dependent while supporting a topographic organization of the representation.

native_neighbors.name: Training signal annealing
native_neighbors.definition: A supervised-loss scheduling procedure that temporarily excludes labeled examples already predicted with confidence above an increasing threshold, gradually allowing more labeled training signal during semi-supervised learning.

native_neighbors.name: Tree-structured Parzen Estimator
native_neighbors.definition: A sequential hyperparameter optimization method that separates observations by a loss quantile, fits tree-structured densities for the better and remaining configurations, and proposes evaluations using their density ratio as an expected-improvement ranking.

native_neighbors.name: TriMap
native_neighbors.definition: A nonlinear dimensionality-reduction algorithm that selects weighted triplet comparisons from high-dimensional data and optimizes embedding coordinates to favor the corresponding ordering of pairwise similarities.

native_neighbors.name: Triplet Markov chain
native_neighbors.definition: A latent-variable sequence-model family that introduces an auxiliary process so that the joint hidden, auxiliary and observed process is first-order Markov, while the hidden–observed pair obtained by marginalizing the auxiliary process need not be Markov.

native_neighbors.name: Triplet Markov field
native_neighbors.definition: A latent-variable spatial-model family that introduces an auxiliary field so the complete hidden, auxiliary and observed triplet has a normalized Gibbs factorization on a specified neighborhood graph, while its hidden–observed projection need not remain Markov on that graph.

native_neighbors.name: Truncated Poisson graphical model
native_neighbors.definition: A finite pairwise count graphical model with a fixed upper count limit, factorial base measures and Poisson-kernel full conditionals renormalized over the bounded support, allowing finite symmetric interactions of either sign.

native_neighbors.name: UMAP
native_neighbors.definition: A nonlinear embedding algorithm that constructs a locally scaled, symmetrized nearest-neighbor similarity graph and places its vertices in a lower-dimensional space using sampled attractive and repulsive updates.

native_neighbors.name: Unadjusted Langevin algorithm
native_neighbors.definition: An approximate sampling algorithm that discretizes overdamped Langevin dynamics by an explicit gradient drift and Gaussian noise without a Metropolis acceptance correction.

native_neighbors.name: Unsupervised Data Augmentation
native_neighbors.definition: A semi-supervised classifier-training procedure that combines labeled prediction loss with consistency between fixed current-model predictions on original or weakly augmented unlabeled inputs and predictions on strongly augmented versions.

native_neighbors.name: Unweighted Multiview Convex Mixture Clustering
native_neighbors.definition: A multiview exemplar-clustering procedure that fits a single vector of exemplar weights by minimizing the equally weighted sum of fixed-component negative log likelihoods across aligned data views, then selects a specified number of exemplars.

native_neighbors.name: VICReg
native_neighbors.definition: A self-supervised joint-embedding procedure that combines a paired-view invariance loss with separate per-branch penalties for insufficient coordinate standard deviation and off-diagonal covariance.

native_neighbors.name: Value-based abstraction functions for abstraction sampling
native_neighbors.definition: A family of graphical-model sampling abstractions that assigns a positive scalar value to each current search node and partitions nodes in value order into abstract states used by the surrounding importance-weighted representative sampler.

native_neighbors.name: Vanilla sequence beam decoding
native_neighbors.definition: A layer-based sequence beam decoder in which completed and unfinished hypotheses compete for the same k beam slots: finished hypotheses are carried forward unchanged, unfinished hypotheses are extended, and the top-scoring candidates form the next beam.

native_neighbors.name: Variational Expectation Maximization
native_neighbors.definition: A latent-variable model-fitting procedure that alternates optimization of a posterior approximation within a specified restricted family and optimization of model parameters using that approximation, targeting an evidence lower bound.

native_neighbors.name: Variational Fair Autoencoder
native_neighbors.definition: A variational autoencoder architecture for learning representations with reduced sensitive or nuisance information, combining sensitive-variable-conditioned inference and generation with an MMD penalty on group-conditional aggregated latent distributions and a semi-supervised predictive component.

native_neighbors.name: Variational message passing
native_neighbors.definition: A variational inference algorithm that organizes conjugate-exponential coordinate updates as local messages carrying expected sufficient statistics and natural-parameter contributions through a Bayesian network.

native_neighbors.name: Variational sparse-spectrum Gaussian-process inference
native_neighbors.definition: The Gal–Turner finite spectral regression inference procedure that factorizes spectral parameters from output coefficients, analytically optimizes an unrestricted Gaussian coefficient factor, and optimizes the resulting evidence lower bound over the spectral variational distribution and model hyperparameters.

native_neighbors.name: Vertex Attention Interaction Network
native_neighbors.definition: A neural architecture for multi-agent predictive modeling that encodes each agent separately, aggregates communication vectors using learned attention-address distances, and combines the aggregate with singleton features for per-agent prediction.

native_neighbors.name: Virtual adversarial training
native_neighbors.definition: A prediction-smoothing regularization procedure that trains a model to preserve its current output distribution under approximately worst-case small input perturbations, constructing those perturbations without using target labels.

native_neighbors.name: Voting classifier
native_neighbors.definition: A classifier combining base predictions through class votes or aggregated class probabilities.

native_neighbors.name: Wake-sleep algorithm
native_neighbors.definition: An alternating learning procedure that trains a generative network from observed data and recognition-sampled hidden states during wake, and trains a recognition network from generative-model samples during sleep.

native_neighbors.name: WalkSAT
native_neighbors.definition: A clause-focused SAT local-search algorithm, in its classical SKC formulation, that first selects an unsatisfied clause, prioritizes a variable with zero breakcount, and otherwise mixes a random variable flip with a minimum-breakcount flip within that clause.

native_neighbors.name: Ward minimum-variance clustering
native_neighbors.definition: An agglomerative clustering algorithm for Euclidean observations that starts from singletons and repeatedly merges the pair causing the smallest increase in total within-cluster squared deviations from cluster means, producing a nested sequence of partitions.

native_neighbors.name: Wavelet-domain hidden Markov model
native_neighbors.definition: A statistical wavelet-coefficient model family using latent mixture states to represent coefficient distributions and Markov dependencies among those states to capture within-scale clustering or cross-scale persistence.

native_neighbors.name: Weighted A-star search
native_neighbors.definition: A heuristic best-first search algorithm that orders open nodes by g+w h using a fixed finite weight w greater than one, where g is path cost so far and h estimates remaining cost.

native_neighbors.name: Weighted Multiview Convex Mixture Clustering
native_neighbors.definition: A multiview exemplar-clustering procedure that learns shared exemplar weights and view weights through outer view-responsibility updates and an inner shared-weight fit, then assigns observations to a specified set of high-weight exemplars.

native_neighbors.name: Weighted Multiview Spectral Clustering
native_neighbors.definition: A multiview clustering algorithm that alternates a leading-eigenspace relaxation of within-cluster variance with simplex weights for a power-weighted combination of fixed view kernels, then discretizes the final embedding.

native_neighbors.name: Whitening mean squared error
native_neighbors.definition: A self-supervised representation-learning procedure that differentiably whitens projected image-view embeddings and minimizes the average squared distance between normalized whitened embeddings of views from the same image.

native_neighbors.name: Zeta merging
native_neighbors.definition: An agglomerative graph-clustering algorithm that selects the pair with the largest sum of conditional increases in average log-diagonal resolvent popularity.

native_neighbors.name: Adversarial debiasing (Zhang et al.)
native_neighbors.definition: An adversarial learning algorithm that trains a task predictor alongside a protected-attribute adversary, modifying the predictor gradient with a projection term and an opposing adversary-loss term to target a selected statistical fairness condition.
